findings.title: Do not assume every font bitmap is PNG
findings.message: GlyphDataBitmap does not guarantee PNG-encoded data: valid font bitmap records can use other image formats, including JPEG. Encountering such a system-font glyph makes the probe panic instead of completing the lazy/eager comparison, even when bitmap loading is correct.
findings.suggestion: Decode according to the returned bitmap format. For supported encoded image formats, use image.Decode with the appropriate decoders registered; handle non-encoded bitmap formats separately and report unsupported formats explicitly rather than treating every record as PNG.

finding.title: Revalidate the backing file after deferred reads
finding.message: The stability check happens before reading, so an in-place modification between Stat and ReadAt is accepted. Deferred requests can consequently combine strike metadata or glyph offsets from the original font with payload bytes from a modified font, violating the stable-resource contract.
finding.suggestion: At minimum, stat the same descriptor again after ReadAt and reject the result if its identity, size, or modification time changed. If strict immutability is required, use an owned immutable snapshot rather than relying solely on filesystem metadata.
